source.title: Keystone metro cost factor (BLS OEWS wages, see README cost method)

factor.note: MSA 11100 Amarillo, TX: labour index L=0.79, materials M=1.0. 5/5 trades (OEWS May 2024 via O*NET Texas local-wages search extracts). Ratios to US: 47-2031 0.776; 47-2111 0.804; 47-2152 0.789; 47-2061 0.784; 49-9021 0.821. L = 0.79; factor = 0.40*0.79 + 0.60*1.00 = 0.92. M=1.00 (default, no public citable reason to adjust).

cost.method: Factor = 0.40*L + 0.60*M, rounded to 2 decimals. L = weighted mean of (metro annual median wage / US national annual median wage) for SOC 47-2031 Carpenters (0.30), 47-2111 Electricians (0.20), 47-2152 Plumbers/Pipefitters/Steamfitters (0.20), 47-2061 Construction Laborers (0.20), 49-9021 HVAC Mechanics/Installers (0.10), from BLS OEWS; weights renormalised over occupations available for the MSA. M = materials index, 1.00 for all Texas metros (no public citable reason to adjust); qualitative materials notes per MSA. Wave 2 (2026-10-11): all five trades retrieved from O*NET Texas local-wages pages (OEWS May 2024) via search extracts (Secondary); HVAC missing for 28660, 47380, 46340, 17780 (weights renormalised there). provisional removed for every MSA with >=4 trades.

plainLanguage: Amarillo uses the 2021 International Residential Code with city amendments; electrical work follows the 2023 National Electrical Code. The Panhandle is climate zone 4B, so walls and ceilings need more insulation than in central Texas. The city requires house footings at least 24 inches deep, deeper than the model code minimum. Single-family zones (R-1, R-2) generally use a 25 ft front and 5 ft side setback and a 35 ft height limit, but check your plat and the city's district table. Hail is common; Class 4 shingles are not required but are widely used, and re-roofs require full tear-off. The building permit was set at about $0.45 per sq ft (about $1,280 for a 2,400 sq ft home with garage); we found no impact fees.
